_doc: Optional economy perks for solo/collection servers (issue #14). gold_rewards_also_grant_platinum: every gold reward (campaign, FRA cash-out, Wheel of Fate gold reels, redeem codes) also grants the same amount of platinum. level_up_currency_per_level: reaching account level N grants N times this much gold and platinum (0 = off; levels reached earlier are not paid out). wheel_paid_respin_refund: a spin that leaves the chest a paid re-spin also grants that spin's gold cost at the chest's new rarity.
